sections.title: Habit and range
sections.text: Dendrocalamus giganteus is a tropical, clump-forming bamboo native from north-eastern India to Yunnan and widely planted. Its culms can reach 20–30 m tall and 20–30 cm in diameter; internodes are about 30–45 cm long.

sections.title: Culms and leaves
sections.text: The leaves are about 15–45 × 3–6 cm. The plate matches the massive culms and foliage; flowering is rare and the detailed inflorescence may be absent from most stands. No specific food use is described here.
